Definitely a step up from the abnormals.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 5 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Skeleton''', which uses a display name of ''Skeleton'' in-game, is an enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, Fallen Arena [[PVP]] mode, [[Badlands II]] and [[The Takeover Event]]. The '''Fallen Skeleton''' can be spawned by the [[Fallen Necromancer]]. In [[Badlands II]], it is turned into a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy for all of its natural spawns. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Skeletons are the remains of those who died as the magic began to fade. The Fallen Necromancers discovered they could bind these bones with cursed energy, giving them life once more. Now, they rise from the ground to serve as shields for their summoners as some wander aimlessly within the army. In death, they finally have purpose, though it is not the kind they had hoped for.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Skeleton''' is made entirely of desaturated sand colored parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is much smaller and is shaped like a skull, with a part of the spine column attached to it. It emits light blue flames from its eye sockets. On death, the '''Fallen Skeleton''' falls into a pile of bones while playing a bone shaking sound. ==Strategy== *The '''Fallen Skeleton''' has much more health than both the [[Abnormal]] and [[Quick]], making it quite dangerous against weak defenses. It is therefore best to invest in additional defense before and after it appears. **Great early game DPS towers like the [[Brawler]], [[Militant]], [[Shotgunner]] and [[Ace Pilot]] can deal with the '''Fallen Skeleton'''. **Stronger towers such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Hunter]] can fare against it more effectively if you can afford them. Utilizing the [[Farm]] and [[Cowboy]] are reccommended to boost your income in case you plan to do so. *Later on in the game, after the [[Fallen Necromancer]] makes its debut, the '''Fallen Skeleton''' can be a threat as many can be summoned by the [[Fallen Necromancer]] if it is not killed quickly, leading to other problems. **Killing the [[Fallen Necromancer]] before it can summon any '''Fallen Skeletons''' is recommended. **Towers like the [[Soldier]], [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can be quite effective against this. **High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] can be prepared specifically for this enemy if early game towers are not enough, using the [[Farm]] to get them as they may be quite expensive. ***Do note that the [[Accelerator]], if locked onto the [[Fallen Necromancer]] or other strong enemies, will ignore the '''Fallen Skeletons''' until the targeted enemy is defeated or leaves its range. ***The [[Ranger]] struggles against hordes of '''Fallen Skeletons''' due to its slow firerate. It can instead be set to ''Strongest'' to target and kill the [[Fallen Necromancer]] while other towers take care of the '''Fallen Skeletons'''. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Gladiator]] can be quite useful as they can damage all the '''Fallen Skeletons''' when they are in a group, as well as the [[Fallen Necromancer]] at once. *While you cannot earn any money from the '''Fallen Skeleton''' outside of [[Badlands II]] as it appears as a summoned enemy later on, you can still gain money from the '''Fallen Skeleton''' when it appears in the early game, as it spawns by itself, making it not a summoned enemy. *The '''Fallen Skeleton''' moves at a somewhat fast pace. You may want to use support towers to slow them down, though this is not usually necessary. **In the early game, cheap stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can be utilized. **Later on, the [[Sledger]], [[Frost Blaster]] and a higher level [[Electroshocker]] are particularly effective as they can slow multiple '''Fallen Skeletons''' down at once. Additionally, their high damage makes them also useful at killing '''Fallen Skeletons'''. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:BrickFall.ogg]] {{!}}Death sound {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenSkeleton.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenSkeleton.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} DJ Tower Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Skeleton''' on a promotional video.
